verdict.rationale: A connection audit log is a fair question for a remote-screen product, so the axis applies. Sill documents a general log file (Show Log… or Library/Logs) and a list of paired devices. Neither is described as a record of who connected to which machine and when, and nothing describes exporting such a record for audit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
